tasks.name: Feed my shoe
tasks.description:
I must feed my shoe, otherwise it is going to kill me. It demands food each year!

A wizard turned my shoe sentient and because I treated it poorly for a long time, it decided to kill me unless it gets fed at least once a year.

tasks.name: Roast the chicken
tasks.description: I need to make a roast of my chicken. The song should be at least 1 minute.
